groups.sentence: Students may ask AI for feedback or critique on their own drafts and writing to find gaps and improve them.
Students may compare their own work or solution with AI output, or check it against a rubric or by verification.
Students may use AI to help revise and edit their own drafts, including restructuring and spotting problems in argument.
Students may use AI as a critical interlocutor that raises objections, gaps and counterarguments against their own work.
Instructors may encourage or ask students to use AI to get feedback on their work.
Instructors may use generative AI to get feedback on their own writing.
